acceptanceCriteria: When B's obligation is witnessed, A's mirror reports witnessed with B as source.
A ticket with only decided mirrors is excluded from dispatch and listed completable.
A mirror whose owner is missing or undecided stays open with a reason.
A parked all-blocked ticket unparks on the first status read after one item unblocks, with a test.
body: Declare an obligation on ticket A as satisfiedBy an obligation on ticket B and derive A's state from B; MIRROR-DECIDED-ELSEWHERE lists A's open items already terminal on their owner; a ticket whose open items are all decided mirrors is excluded from dispatch and listed as completable. Also (#1177 comment): when an item under a ticket parked as all-items-blocked leaves blocked, the ticket is unparked and gets a worker; doctor reports it.
title: GH #1214: obligation mirrors (satisfiedBy) and MIRROR-DECIDED-ELSEWHERE; plus #1177 follow-up: unpark a parked ticket when any item leaves blocked
